instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium-wide shot from behind shows an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpeted floor and white walls. The man in the black cap (R1) in a dark polo shirt and blue shorts stands on the left, and the woman in the white patterned t-shirt (R2) in blue jeans stands on the right. She wraps her left arm around his waist, raising her left hand behind his shoulder to make a peace sign, while extending her right arm to point to the side. The room is brightly lit with overhead lights, with an office printer visible in the background.
